findings.disposition: Supported source occurrence; no runtime reproduction in this pass.
findings.cause: Raw server/proxy JoinHandles span fallible configuration, build, prepared-template, send and body operations. Success-only joins are skipped on error; moving raw handles into timeout detaches them on expiry. The resolved JoinHandle contract establishes detachment and lost result, not permanent/natural resource leakage.
findings.qualification: H2/H3 completion receivers wake when sender is dropped, once those workers reach their completion wait; that mitigates some paths but does not cancel earlier accept/TLS/request phases or collect completed peer causes. Runtime teardown may cancel detached work. No independent sibling spawn exists inside single H2/H3 origin worker.
findings.remedy: Immediately adopt each actual spawned task in existing concrete ConnectionPeer and retain client through explicit finite cleanup. Save operation outcome, independently collect/stop peer, and compose original causes with existing finish_with_cleanup. Keep original wire/order/observer algorithms. No generic framework.
findings.regression_contract: Healthy actual HTTP/1/2/3 fields/204 positives. A separate actual pending accepted/read witness with original AbortHandle and destructor/socket observation must precede cancellation/backup. A completed post-wire typed peer error plus a separate original caller error must remain individually identifiable after helper return. Instrument only actual canonical phases; do not duplicate server algorithms or infer lifetime from spawn alone.

findings.disposition: Supported source suppression; deliberate EOF policy must be retained.
findings.cause: serve_http1_replies treats every read_head error as successful completion. read_head itself returns InvalidData at32768 bytes and propagates read failures, so these are silently converted to Ok(request_count) along with intended final disconnect. Count alone cannot establish no partial extra request bytes.
findings.remedy: Give this concrete fixture an explicit head-versus-clean-disconnect policy. Retain expected peer closure, return original unrelated read/bound failures, and distinguish incomplete head if that contract is required. Do not blanket change shared read_head or runtime HTTP parsing.
findings.regression_contract: After a real trusted first GET/literal204, healthy client EOF remains a success count1. A second actual32768-byte unterminated head must retain the canonical InvalidData error, not Ok(1). If local-reader identity coverage is required, inject a typed original I/O cause only after actual read Pending and require exact contained marker before finite backup. Test malformed trusted-fixture input, not claim a production parser vulnerability.

findings.cause: Module declarations and two local support aliases precede standard/external imports. Attached standards require imports before module declarations and std/external/local grouping.
findings.remedy: Move unchanged imports into ordered groups before declarations; preserve identities, attributes and body bytes. No behavioral tests for a literal layout-only inverse.
